rules.from: The key to the sealed box was received by the Council of Elders together with the three-page will.
The circumstances of the disappearance and the contents of the three-page will have not been determined.
The confirmed fact was entered in the witness column of the three-page will.
봉인함의 열쇠는 유언 3장과 함께 원로회에 접수되었다.
실종의 경위와 유언 3장의 내용은 정해지지 않았다.
확인 사실은 유언 3장의 증인 칸에 기재되었다.
